# SCIM `Users` API reference

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:intro -->
This topic provides reference information for the public SCIM user provisioning endpoints under `/scim/v2/Users`.

Refer to the [Public SCIM API](/terraform/enterprise/api-docs/scim) for shared authentication, discovery endpoints, pagination, supported filters, and shared rate limits.
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:intro -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:intro -->
This topic provides reference information for the SCIM user provisioning endpoints under `/scim/v2/:scim_configuration_id/Users`.

Refer to the [SCIM API](/terraform/cloud-docs/api-docs/scim) for shared authentication, discovery endpoints, pagination, supported filters, and rate limits.
<!-- END: TFC:only name:intro -->

## List SCIM users

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:list-users -->
The following endpoint returns SCIM-managed users. Without a filter, Terraform Enterprise returns a paginated SCIM list response.

`GET /scim/v2/Users`
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:list-users -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:list-users -->
The following endpoint returns SCIM-managed users in the organization. Without a filter, HCP Terraform returns a paginated SCIM list response.

`GET /scim/v2/:scim_configuration_id/Users`
<!-- END: TFC:only name:list-users -->

### Query parameters

| Parameter    | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ------------ | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `filter`     |         | Optional SCIM filter. Supported values are `userName eq "value"` and `externalId eq "value"`. Matches for `userName` are case-insensitive. Matches for `externalId` are exact. |
| `startIndex` | `1`     | The first record to return.                                                                                                                                                    |
| `count`      | `100`   | The maximum number of records to return. <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:count-cap -->Terraform Enterprise<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:count-cap --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:count-cap -->HCP Terraform<!-- END: TFC:only name:count-cap --> caps this value at `200`. Set `count=0` to return only `totalResults`. |

### Response codes

| Status  | Response                | Reason                                             |
| ------- | ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| [200][] | SCIM 2.0 list response  | Successfully listed SCIM users                     |
| [400][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Unsupported filter expression or malformed request |
| [401][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Missing, invalid, expired, or non-SCIM token       |
| [403][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | SCIM is <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:403 -->disabled or paused<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:403 --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:403 -->disabled<!-- END: TFC:only name:403 --> |
| [429][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Rate limit exceeded                                |
| [500][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Internal error while listing SCIM users            |

### Sample request

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:list-sample-request -->
```shell
$ curl \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  --request GET \
  "https://tfe.example.com/scim/v2/Users?filter=userName%20eq%20%22user%40example.com%22"
```
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:list-sample-request -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:list-sample-request -->
```shell
$ curl \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  --request GET \
  "https://app.terraform.io/scim/v2/$SCIM_CONFIGURATION_ID/Users?filter=userName%20eq%20%22user%40example.com%22"
```
<!-- END: TFC:only name:list-sample-request -->

### Sample response

```json
{
	"schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:ListResponse"],
	"totalResults": 1,
	"startIndex": 1,
	"itemsPerPage": 1,
	"Resources": [
		{
			"schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
			"id": "52f5ecb9-59db-4f8d-9c9b-c2ec9a39e126",
			"externalId": "ext-999",
			"userName": "user@example.com",
			"name": {
				"formatted": "user"
			},
			"emails": [
				{
					"value": "user@example.com",
					"primary": true
				}
			],
			"active": true,
			"meta": {
				"resourceType": "User",
				"created": "2026-01-15T10:30:00Z",
				"lastModified": "2026-01-15T10:30:00Z"
			}
		}
	]
}
```

## Show a SCIM user

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:show-users -->
The following endpoint returns a single SCIM user resource.

`GET /scim/v2/Users/:id`
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:show-users -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:show-users -->
The following endpoint returns a single SCIM user resource in the organization.

`GET /scim/v2/:scim_configuration_id/Users/:id`
<!-- END: TFC:only name:show-users -->

### Path parameters

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:show-path-params -->
| Parameter | Description                                         |
| --------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `:id`     | The SCIM user ID returned in the user's `id` field. |
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:show-path-params -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:show-path-params -->
| Parameter                | Description                                               |
| ------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `:scim_configuration_id` | The external ID of the organization's SCIM configuration. |
| `:id`                    | The SCIM user ID returned in the user's `id` field.       |
<!-- END: TFC:only name:show-path-params -->

### Response codes

| Status  | Response                | Reason                                       |
| ------- | ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| [200][] | SCIM 2.0 user resource  | Successfully returned the user               |
| [401][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Missing, invalid, expired, or non-SCIM token |
| [403][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | SCIM is <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:403 -->disabled or paused<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:403 --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:403 -->disabled<!-- END: TFC:only name:403 --> |
| [404][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | User not found                               |
| [429][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Rate limit exceeded                          |
| [500][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Internal error while loading the user        |

### Sample request

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:show-sample-request -->
```shell
$ curl \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  --request GET \
  "https://tfe.example.com/scim/v2/Users/52f5ecb9-59db-4f8d-9c9b-c2ec9a39e126"
```
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:show-sample-request -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:show-sample-request -->
```shell
$ curl \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  --request GET \
  "https://app.terraform.io/scim/v2/$SCIM_CONFIGURATION_ID/Users/52f5ecb9-59db-4f8d-9c9b-c2ec9a39e126"
```
<!-- END: TFC:only name:show-sample-request -->

## Create a SCIM user

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:create-users -->
The following endpoint provisions a new SCIM user. If Terraform Enterprise already has a manually managed user with the same email address, Terraform Enterprise links that existing user to the new SCIM identity instead of creating a duplicate user record.

`POST /scim/v2/Users`
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:create-users -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:create-users -->
The following endpoint provisions a new SCIM user. If the organization already has a member with the same email address, HCP Terraform links that existing user to the new SCIM identity instead of creating a duplicate user record.

`POST /scim/v2/:scim_configuration_id/Users`
<!-- END: TFC:only name:create-users -->

| Status  | Response                | Reason                                              |
| ------- | ----------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| [201][] | SCIM 2.0 user resource  | Successfully created or linked the user             |
| [400][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Malformed JSON or missing email data                |
| [401][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Missing, invalid, expired, or non-SCIM token        |
| [403][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | SCIM is <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:403 -->disabled or paused<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:403 --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:403 -->disabled<!-- END: TFC:only name:403 --> |
| [409][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | A SCIM user with the same `userName` already exists |
| [413][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Request body too large                              |
| [429][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Rate limit exceeded                                 |
| [500][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Internal error while creating the user              |

### Request body

This endpoint accepts a SCIM 2.0 `User` resource in the request body.

| Key path           | Type   | Default | Description                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------------ | ------ | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `schemas[]`        | array  |         | Include `"urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"`.                                                                                     |
| `userName`         | string |         | The SCIM user name. <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:username-uniqueness -->Terraform Enterprise<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:username-uniqueness --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:username-uniqueness -->HCP Terraform<!-- END: TFC:only name:username-uniqueness --> preserves the provided casing but enforces uniqueness case-insensitively. |
| `externalId`       | string |         | Optional identity-provider identifier for the user.                                                                                         |
| `emails[]`         | array  |         | Include at least one email object. <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:email-primary -->Terraform Enterprise<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:email-primary --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:email-primary -->HCP Terraform<!-- END: TFC:only name:email-primary --> uses either the entry marked `primary=true` or the first entry if none is marked primary. |
| `emails[].value`   | string |         | The user's email address.                                                                                                                   |
| `emails[].primary` | bool   |         | Marks the primary email entry.                                                                                                              |
| `active`           | bool   | `true`  | When `false`, <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:active-create -->Terraform Enterprise<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:active-create --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:active-create -->HCP Terraform<!-- END: TFC:only name:active-create --> creates the user in a suspended state. |
| `name.givenName`   | string |         | Optional SCIM name field accepted from identity providers. <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:name-persist -->Terraform Enterprise<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:name-persist --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:name-persist -->HCP Terraform<!-- END: TFC:only name:name-persist --> does not persist SCIM name fields. |
| `name.familyName`  | string |         | Optional SCIM name field accepted from identity providers. <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:name-persist -->Terraform Enterprise<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:name-persist --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:name-persist -->HCP Terraform<!-- END: TFC:only name:name-persist --> does not persist SCIM name fields. |

### Sample request

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:create-sample-request -->
```shell
$ curl \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --request POST \
  --data '{
    "schemas": [
      "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"
    ],
    "userName": "user@example.com",
    "externalId": "ext-999",
    "emails": [
      {
        "value": "user@example.com",
        "primary": true
      }
    ],
    "active": true
  }' \
  "https://tfe.example.com/scim/v2/Users"
```
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:create-sample-request -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:create-sample-request -->
```shell
$ curl \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --request POST \
  --data '{
    "schemas": [
      "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"
    ],
    "userName": "user@example.com",
    "externalId": "ext-999",
    "emails": [

        "value": "user@example.com",
        "primary": true
      }
    ],
    "active": true
  }' \

```
<!-- END: TFC:only name:create-sample-request -->

	"id": "52f5ecb9-59db-4f8d-9c9b-c2ec9a39e126",

	"externalId": "ext-999",

		"formatted": "user"
	},

## Replace a SCIM user

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:replace-users -->
The following endpoint replaces the SCIM-managed attributes for an existing user. Include the full SCIM `User` resource body. Terraform Enterprise requires email data on replace requests.

`PUT /scim/v2/Users/:id`
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:replace-users -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:replace-users -->
The following endpoint replaces the SCIM-managed attributes for an existing user. Include the full SCIM `User` resource body. HCP Terraform requires email data on replace requests.

`PUT /scim/v2/:scim_configuration_id/Users/:id`

If the `PUT` request targets a user who is not scoped to the current organization, such as a user who was provisioned by a different organization's SCIM configuration HCP Terraform rejects the request with an error rather than allowing a cross-organization mutation.
<!-- END: TFC:only name:replace-users -->

### Path parameters

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:replace-path-params -->
| Parameter | Description                                         |
| --------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `:id`     | The SCIM user ID returned in the user's `id` field. |
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:replace-path-params -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:replace-path-params -->
| Parameter                | Description                                               |
| ------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `:scim_configuration_id` | The external ID of the organization's SCIM configuration. |
| `:id`                    | The SCIM user ID returned in the user's `id` field.       |
<!-- END: TFC:only name:replace-path-params -->

| Status  | Response                | Reason                                       |
| ------- | ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| [200][] | SCIM 2.0 user resource  | Successfully replaced the user               |
| [400][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Malformed JSON or missing email data         |
| [401][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Missing, invalid, expired, or non-SCIM token |
| [403][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | SCIM is <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:403 -->disabled or paused<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:403 --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:403 -->disabled<!-- END: TFC:only name:403 --> |
| [404][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | User not found                               |
| [409][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | A conflicting `userName` already exists      |
| [413][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Request body too large                       |
| [429][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Rate limit exceeded                          |
| [500][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Internal error while replacing the user      |

### Request body

This endpoint accepts a full SCIM `User` resource body.

| Key path           | Type   | Default | Description                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------------ | ------ | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `schemas[]`        | array  |         | Include `"urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"`.                                                                                     |
| `userName`         | string |         | The SCIM user name. <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:username-uniqueness -->Terraform Enterprise<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:username-uniqueness --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:username-uniqueness -->HCP Terraform<!-- END: TFC:only name:username-uniqueness --> preserves the provided casing but enforces uniqueness case-insensitively. |
| `externalId`       | string |         | Optional identity-provider identifier for the user.                                                                                         |
| `emails[]`         | array  |         | Include at least one email object. <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:email-primary -->Terraform Enterprise<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:email-primary --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:email-primary -->HCP Terraform<!-- END: TFC:only name:email-primary --> uses either the entry marked `primary=true` or the first entry if none is marked primary. |
| `emails[].value`   | string |         | The user's email address.                                                                                                                   |
| `emails[].primary` | bool   |         | Marks the primary email entry.                                                                                                              |
| `active`           | bool   |         | When `false`, <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:active-replace -->Terraform Enterprise<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:active-replace --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:active-replace -->HCP Terraform<!-- END: TFC:only name:active-replace --> suspends the user. When omitted, <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:active-replace -->Terraform Enterprise<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:active-replace --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:active-replace -->HCP Terraform<!-- END: TFC:only name:active-replace --> leaves the current suspension state unchanged. |
| `name.givenName`   | string |         | Optional SCIM name field accepted from identity providers. <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:name-persist -->Terraform Enterprise<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:name-persist --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:name-persist -->HCP Terraform<!-- END: TFC:only name:name-persist --> does not persist SCIM name fields. |
| `name.familyName`  | string |         | Optional SCIM name field accepted from identity providers. <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:name-persist -->Terraform Enterprise<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:name-persist --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:name-persist -->HCP Terraform<!-- END: TFC:only name:name-persist --> does not persist SCIM name fields. |

### Sample request

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:replace-sample-request -->
```shell
$ curl \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --request PUT \
  --data '{
    "schemas": [
      "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"
    ],
    "userName": "user@example.com",
    "externalId": "ext-1000",
    "emails": [
      {
        "value": "user@example.com",
        "primary": true
      }
    ],
    "active": true
  }' \
  "https://tfe.example.com/scim/v2/Users/52f5ecb9-59db-4f8d-9c9b-c2ec9a39e126"
```
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:replace-sample-request -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:replace-sample-request -->

$ curl \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \

## Patch a SCIM user

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:patch-users -->
The following endpoint partially updates a SCIM user with a SCIM `PatchOp` request body.

`PATCH /scim/v2/Users/:id`
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:patch-users -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:patch-users -->
The following endpoint partially updates a SCIM user with a SCIM `PatchOp` request body.

`PATCH /scim/v2/:scim_configuration_id/Users/:id`

If the `PATCH` request targets a user who is not scoped to the current organization, such as a user who was provisioned by a different organization's SCIM configuration HCP Terraform rejects the request with an error rather than allowing a cross-organization mutation.
<!-- END: TFC:only name:patch-users -->

### Path parameters

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:patch-path-params -->
| Parameter | Description                                         |
| --------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `:id`     | The SCIM user ID returned in the user's `id` field. |
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:patch-path-params -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:patch-path-params -->
| Parameter                | Description                                               |
| ------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `:scim_configuration_id` | The external ID of the organization's SCIM configuration. |
| `:id`                    | The SCIM user ID returned in the user's `id` field.       |
<!-- END: TFC:only name:patch-path-params -->

### Response codes

| Status  | Response                | Reason                                                              |
| ------- | ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [200][] | SCIM 2.0 user resource  | Successfully updated the user                                       |
| [400][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Malformed JSON, unsupported PATCH operation, or too many operations |
| [401][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Missing, invalid, expired, or non-SCIM token                        |
| [403][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | SCIM is <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:403 -->disabled or paused<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:403 --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:403 -->disabled<!-- END: TFC:only name:403 --> |
| [404][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | User not found                                                      |
| [409][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | A conflicting `userName` already exists                             |
| [413][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Request body too large                                              |
| [429][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Rate limit exceeded                                                 |
| [500][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Internal error while updating the user                              |

### Request body

| Key path             | Type   | Description                                                                                           |
| -------------------- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `schemas[]`          | array  | Include `"urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"`.                                            |
| `Operations[]`       | array  | Up to 100 patch operations.                                                                           |
| `Operations[].op`    | string | Supported values are `Add`, `Replace`, and `Remove`.                                                  |
| `Operations[].path`  | string | Target attribute path. Supported targeted paths are `active`, `userName`, `externalId`, and `emails`. |
| `Operations[].value` | mixed  | The replacement value, added value, or bulk attribute object.                                         |

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:patch-ops -->
Terraform Enterprise supports the following `PATCH` operations:
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:patch-ops -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:patch-ops -->
HCP Terraform supports the following `PATCH` operations:
<!-- END: TFC:only name:patch-ops -->

- `Replace` on `active`, `userName`, `externalId`, and `emails`.
- `Add` on `active`, `userName`, `externalId`, and `emails`, which <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:product-name -->Terraform Enterprise<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:product-name --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:product-name -->HCP Terraform<!-- END: TFC:only name:product-name --> treats the same as `Replace`.
- `Replace` or `Add` without a `path`, where `value` is an object containing one or more supported attributes.
- `Remove` only for `externalId`.

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:product-name -->
Terraform Enterprise ignores attempts to clear required attributes such as `userName`, `emails`, or `active`.
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:product-name -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:product-name -->
HCP Terraform ignores attempts to clear required attributes such as `userName`, `emails`, or `active`.
<!-- END: TFC:only name:product-name -->

### Sample request

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:patch-sample-request -->
```shell
$ curl \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --request PATCH \
  --data '{
    "schemas": [
      "urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"
    ],
    "Operations": [
      {
        "op": "Replace",
        "path": "active",
        "value": false
      }
    ]
  }' \
  "https://tfe.example.com/scim/v2/Users/52f5ecb9-59db-4f8d-9c9b-c2ec9a39e126"
```
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:patch-sample-request -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:patch-sample-request -->
```shell
$ curl \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --request PATCH \
  --data '{
    "schemas": [
      "urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"
    ],
    "Operations": [
      {
        "op": "Replace",
        "path": "active",
        "value": false
      }
    ]
  }' \
  "https://app.terraform.io/scim/v2/$SCIM_CONFIGURATION_ID/Users/52f5ecb9-59db-4f8d-9c9b-c2ec9a39e126"
```

## Delete a SCIM user

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:delete-users -->
The following endpoint deprovisions a SCIM user. Terraform Enterprise removes the SCIM identity, suspends the underlying Terraform Enterprise user record, and revokes SCIM-granted site administrator access if applicable.

`DELETE /scim/v2/Users/:id`
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:delete-users -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:delete-users -->
The following endpoint deprovisions a SCIM user. HCP Terraform removes the user's organization membership and SCIM identity. The underlying user account is preserved, as it may belong to other organizations.

`DELETE /scim/v2/:scim_configuration_id/Users/:id`

<!-- TODO: link to how-to -->
<!-- END: TFC:only name:delete-users -->

### Path parameters

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:delete-path-params -->
| Parameter | Description                                         |
| --------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `:id`     | The SCIM user ID returned in the user's `id` field. |
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:delete-path-params -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:delete-path-params -->
| Parameter                | Description                                               |
| ------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `:scim_configuration_id` | The external ID of the organization's SCIM configuration. |
| `:id`                    | The SCIM user ID returned in the user's `id` field.       |
<!-- END: TFC:only name:delete-path-params -->

### Response codes

| Status  | Response                | Reason                                       |
| ------- | ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| [204][] | No content              | Successfully deprovisioned the user          |
| [401][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Missing, invalid, expired, or non-SCIM token |
| [403][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | SCIM is <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:403 -->disabled or paused<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:403 --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:403 -->disabled<!-- END: TFC:only name:403 --> |
| [404][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | User not found                               |
| [429][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Rate limit exceeded                          |
| [500][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Internal error while deleting the user       |

### Sample request

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:delete-sample-request -->
```shell
$ curl \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  --request DELETE \
  "https://tfe.example.com/scim/v2/Users/52f5ecb9-59db-4f8d-9c9b-c2ec9a39e126"
```
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:delete-sample-request -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:delete-sample-request -->
```shell
$ curl \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  --request DELETE \
  "https://app.terraform.io/scim/v2/$SCIM_CONFIGURATION_ID/Users/52f5ecb9-59db-4f8d-9c9b-c2ec9a39e126"
```
<!-- END: TFC:only name:delete-sample-request -->

### Sample response

A successful request returns a `204 No Content` response with no body.

## Response attributes

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:product-name -->
Terraform Enterprise returns the following attributes in a SCIM user resource.
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:product-name -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:product-name -->
HCP Terraform returns the following attributes in a SCIM user resource.
<!-- END: TFC:only name:product-name -->

| Attribute           | Type      | Description                                                            |
| ------------------- | --------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `schemas[]`         | array     | Always includes `"urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"`.        |
| `id`                | string    | The SCIM user ID returned by <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:product-name -->Terraform Enterprise<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:product-name --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:product-name -->HCP Terraform<!-- END: TFC:only name:product-name -->. |
| `externalId`        | string    | The identity-provider identifier stored for the user.                  |
| `userName`          | string    | The SCIM user name stored for the user.                                |
| `name.formatted`    | string    | The <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:product-name -->Terraform Enterprise<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:product-name --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:product-name -->HCP Terraform<!-- END: TFC:only name:product-name --> username associated with the user. |
| `emails[]`          | array     | The user's primary email information.                                  |
| `emails[].value`    | string    | The stored email address for the user.                                 |
| `emails[].primary`  | bool      | Always `true` for the returned primary email entry.                    |
| `active`            | bool      | `true` when the user is active and `false` when the user is suspended. |
| `meta.resourceType` | string    | Always `"User"`.                                                       |
| `meta.created`      | timestamp | The time the SCIM identity was created.                                |
| `meta.lastModified` | timestamp | The time the SCIM identity was last updated.                           |

### Sample SCIM user resource

```json
{
	"schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
	"id": "52f5ecb9-59db-4f8d-9c9b-c2ec9a39e126",
	"externalId": "ext-999",
	"userName": "user@example.com",
	"name": {
		"formatted": "user"
	},
	"emails": [
		{
			"value": "user@example.com",
			"primary": true
		}
	],
	"active": true,
	"meta": {
		"resourceType": "User",
		"created": "2026-01-15T10:30:00Z",
		"lastModified": "2026-01-15T10:30:00Z"
	}
}
```

## Rate limiting

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:rate-limit -->
The public `/scim/v2/Users` and `/scim/v2/Groups` endpoints share a default rate limit of 10 requests per second. When you exceed this limit, Terraform Enterprise returns HTTP [429][] with a `Retry-After` header.
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:rate-limit -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:rate-limit -->
The SCIM provisioning endpoints share a default rate limit of 30 requests per second. When you exceed this limit, HCP Terraform returns HTTP [429][] with a `Retry-After` header.
<!-- END: TFC:only name:rate-limit -->
